tracesTo: SOW: Public League Support - Conversion flows for public league visitors
UserFlow: Visitor to Registered User Conversion
Gap Analysis: Priority 1 - Public league signup prompts and conversion (0% coverage)

stories.title: Display Contextual Sign-Up Prompts for Public League Visitors
stories.goal: receive relevant prompts to create an account when interacting with gated features
stories.benefit: I understand the value of creating an account and can easily sign up
acceptanceCriteria: System displays 'Login to Participate' overlay when visitor attempts to interact with disabled features (post, comment, trade)
Sign-up prompts are contextual and explain the specific feature requiring authentication (e.g., 'Login to add your own power rankings')
Visitor sees subtle persistent sign-up CTA in navigation or header (e.g., 'Join League' button)
System shows modal or tooltip prompts after visitor has viewed multiple pages without signing up
Sign-up prompts include benefits tailored to public league context (e.g., 'Create account to join this league')
Prompts are non-intrusive and dismissible without blocking content viewing
System tracks visitor engagement and shows progressive prompts based on time spent or pages viewed
Each prompt includes both 'Sign Up' and 'Login' options for returning users
System uses clear visual hierarchy with primary CTA for sign-up and secondary for login
Prompts are mobile-responsive and don't cover critical content on small screens
System avoids showing same prompt repeatedly within single session (frequency capping)
Exit-intent modal triggers when visitor attempts to leave site from public league page

stories.title: Complete Seamless Sign-Up Flow from Public League Page
stories.user: Public League Visitor Ready to Join
stories.goal: create an account without losing my place in the league I'm viewing
stories.benefit: I can quickly sign up and return to the league content that interested me
acceptanceCriteria: Visitor can initiate sign-up from any public league page via contextual CTA
System opens registration form as modal overlay without full page navigation (preserving context)
Registration form is streamlined with minimal required fields (email, password, display name)
System pre-populates league context in registration flow (e.g., 'Join [League Name]')
Visitor can complete entire registration process without leaving league page
System sends verification email immediately upon account creation
System provides option to verify email later to reduce friction in initial sign-up
Form includes clear password requirements and real-time validation feedback
System offers social login options (Google, Apple) as alternatives to email/password
Error messages are inline and specific to help visitor correct issues quickly
System includes privacy policy and terms of service links in registration form
Registration form is mobile-optimized with appropriate keyboard types and autofill support

stories.title: Route Newly Registered User to Appropriate Post-Signup Destination
stories.user: Newly Registered User from Public League
stories.goal: land on the right page after signing up based on my original intent
stories.benefit: I can immediately engage with the feature or content that prompted me to sign up
acceptanceCriteria: System returns user to original public league page after successful registration
User sees confirmation message acknowledging successful sign-up
System automatically displays 'Join League' or 'Request to Join' prompt based on league type
If user was viewing specific content (post, matchup, team), system returns to that exact view
System activates previously disabled interactive features (comment, like, post) after authentication
User sees brief onboarding tooltip highlighting now-available features (e.g., 'You can now participate in discussions')
System preserves any scroll position or filter/sort settings from pre-registration view
If email verification is required, system displays prominent banner with verification status and resend option
User can seamlessly join the public league without additional navigation steps
System tracks conversion source (which prompt or page led to sign-up) for analytics
First-time user experience guide is available but optional to prevent signup-to-engagement friction
System provides quick profile completion prompt (avatar, bio) without blocking league access

stories.title: Handle Returning User Login from Public League Context
stories.goal: quickly log in and access the public league I was viewing
stories.benefit: I can authenticate efficiently and resume my league exploration
acceptanceCriteria: System provides 'Login' option alongside 'Sign Up' in all conversion prompts
Login form opens as modal overlay preserving league page context
Form includes 'Remember Me' option for persistent session across visits
System supports password autofill from browser password managers
User can access 'Forgot Password' flow without leaving public league page
Login form includes social login options (Google, Apple) for faster authentication
System returns user to original league page view after successful login
Previously disabled features become immediately available after authentication
System handles login errors gracefully with clear actionable guidance
User can toggle between login and sign-up forms without losing league context
System redirects to email verification if account exists but is unverified
Login flow is optimized for mobile with appropriate keyboard and input types

stories.title: Track and Optimize Public League Conversion Funnel
stories.goal: measure conversion rates from public league visitors to registered users
stories.benefit: product team can optimize sign-up experience and increase user acquisition
acceptanceCriteria: System tracks unique visitors to public league pages with anonymous analytics
System records engagement metrics (page views, time on page, sections viewed) for visitors
System logs conversion funnel stages (visitor → prompt shown → sign-up initiated → account created)
System tracks which prompts and CTAs lead to highest conversion rates
System records bounce rate and exit pages for visitors who don't convert
System measures time from first visit to sign-up completion
Analytics dashboard shows conversion rate by traffic source (direct link, search, referral)
System tracks sign-up abandonment points (which form fields cause drop-off)
System records post-signup engagement (did user join league, post content, return to site)
System A/B tests different prompt timing, messaging, and designs for conversion optimization
System provides cohort analysis comparing public league visitors vs. other acquisition channels
All tracking complies with privacy regulations with appropriate consent mechanisms

stories.title: Provide Social Proof and League Highlights to Drive Conversion
stories.goal: see evidence of active engaged community before committing to sign up
stories.benefit: I can make informed decision about joining based on league quality and activity
acceptanceCriteria: System displays league activity metrics on public pages (active members, posts this week, trades completed)
Visitor can see recent activity feed showing community engagement without detailed content access
System highlights league size and how long league has been active (e.g., '3rd season, 12 active managers')
Visitor sees anonymous testimonials or quotes from league members (if available)
System displays league competitiveness indicators (tight standings, active waiver wire, trade volume)
Public league pages show league commissioner name/profile (if public) to establish credibility
System highlights unique league features or rules that differentiate this league
Visitor can see how many users have joined in recent period (e.g., '5 new members this week')
System displays league engagement score or activity rating if calculated
Public pages include trust indicators (verified league, years active, platform badges)
System shows upcoming league events or milestones (draft date, playoffs starting, championship)
Social proof elements are dynamic and update regularly to reflect current activity
